hints.title: Upper Bound on Palindromes
hints.text: You cannot construct more palindromes than the total number of characters, so check k <= len(s).

hints.title: Odd Frequency Characters
hints.text: Every palindrome can accommodate at most one character with an odd frequency placed in its center.

hints.title: Lower Bound on Palindromes
hints.text: The number of characters with odd counts cannot exceed k: odd_count <= k.
